explanation:
Eleven batches partition the 69 supplied commits in their exact order. Batch b01 contains exactly first-batch.json. Boundaries follow architectural transitions; documentation, empty evidence diffs, and small fixes remain with related implementation work. Each batch depends on the preceding frozen canvas state. Source paths select endpoint implementations and relevant unchanged dependencies; futureDependencies are organizational evidence only and must not be presented as implemented early.

Evidence limitation: commit-001.json names e883718ed42d4f2174e3b1a4429396a6fc5bb180 as its parent, while the supplied baseline revision is 03f2168deba364103c2450ca9b8168cd1fc9ddc5. Preserve the supplied sequence and verified canvas baseline; do not invent an intervening diff or commit.

C00-C06 are the principal implementation explanations. C07 contains future revision/presentation designs and C09 contains future saved-view behavior; their status is corrected first, then their existing identities are developed when implementation arrives. C08 remains a library reference. C10-C15 remain archived proposal or roll-up references, not synchronized implementation overviews; b01 explicitly labels their status without changing their relationships. The proposed SearchArtifact branch in C04 remains explicitly proposed throughout. The unused C02/D00 placeholder is retained.

All edits preserve every supplied retainedAttachments label exactly, including spacing and multiline labels. When a retained label names a superseded API, preserve it under an explicitly historical branch and explain its replacement nearby. Preserve existing edges and positions; the edges arrays contain only new relationships. Existing diagram edits use their original rectangles and concise ownership summaries, with detail delegated to linked diagrams. No canvas is flattened or relaid out.

New diagrams have fixed positions and exact introductory counts of nonempty concept lines. Reserve at least 100 columns and 2*targetNodes+3 rows for each scaffold; the specified positions leave additional horizontal and vertical clearance. Later edits retain these identities, positions, and node budgets by replacing or consolidating concept lines. Attachment labels named in new edges must occur exactly once in the corresponding diagram. Instructions describe content to produce in Phase 2, not completed ASCII diagrams.

batches.title: Native Canvas Runtime
batches.rationale: Use the required initial range. The controller remains the semantic document owner, while tldraw acquires live geometry, camera, and native undo responsibility. Patch the domain overview because its workspace/controller/history organization remains useful; introduce a separate application-runtime diagram on C00 because granular subscriptions and local anchors already form a distinct explanation and later routing and side-panel changes develop it substantially. C08 explains tldraw internals, so adding application ownership there would mix abstraction levels. Correct inherited future-design status immediately without implementing those designs. Context upload and deletion changes fit existing explanations.

futureDependencies.reason: Obstacle routing and drag-selection ownership develop the native runtime; reserve a reusable integration diagram now.
Alternative controls and side-panel shapes later extend the same runtime, without being shown in this batch.
The inherited revision/presentation diagrams anticipate this later implementation and must initially be labelled as designs.
Named branching views and presentation alternatives arrive later; their baseline depictions are not current functionality.
